verdict.rationale: The Colorado Secretary of State is a government business-registry and filing authority. Its core 'product' is a legally authoritative state service, not deployable software, so self-hosting it is a category error for this kind of product. The downloadable open datasets on data.colorado.gov are data access, not a self-hostable version of the registry, and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
